items.title: The end of humanity? What would happen if the Yellowstone supervolcano erupted now
items.summary_raw: A Yellowstone super-eruption would begin not with a sudden surprise, but with weeks of increasingly alarming warning signs such as migrating earthquake swarms, rapid ground uplift, changing geysers, and rising volcanic gases.
